notes.title: Final YASUKE QA Build Update
notes.notes:
- Minor fixes to movement positioning during certain air attacks and launchers
- Changes to Lion sword throw animations and travel trajectory when enemies are nearby
- Changes to Cheetah multi-slash teleport speed while airborne
- Minor adjustments to hit forces and properties of various attacks
- Adjustments to door opening speed and collision properties in Mission mode
- Added Difficulty selection for Mission mode
- Added option for disabling/enabling camera shake effects in main menu
- Added options for disabling/enabling HUD elements in main menu
- Experimental Automatic mode for default camera movement added as option in main menu
- Fixes to walk speeds not properly being set between modes
- Fixes to speed visual effects being displayed while stationary
- Fix to player being able to move during throw moves
- Added prototype combo grading system
- Reduced recovery on dodges
- Ability to dodge backwards, forwards, and without lock on added
- Adjustments to Playtest map visuals
- Adjustments to various VFX
- Minor fixes to certain SFX

notes.title: YASUKE QA Test Build 1.2
notes.notes:
*Adjustments to character movement while performing Light/Heavy attacks.
*Added ability to cancel Shiryoku Grapple by jumping
*Adjustments to lock on target selection. 
*Visual adjustments to mouse cursor in menus
*Adjustments to positioning and text of tutorial messages in Playtest mode
*Adjustments to grind movement, added ability to cancel by hitting a target with Shiryoku Grapple
*Minor adjustments to Shiryoku Grapple swing forces and travel speed
*Minor adjustments to vault animation speeds
*Adjustments to various VFX
*Minor adjustments to base movement values between Parkour/Combat modes

notes.title: QA Test Build version 1.11
notes.notes:
- Fixed major bug within character death event.
- Version number added within menu

notes.title: QA Test Build version 1.10
notes.notes:
- Fix to certain rooms not loading in Mission mode
- Fix to certain objects in Mission Mode not being ledge grabbable.
- Adjustments to input buffering for Light/Heavy/Dash Attacks
- Adjustments to teleport positioning and attack behaviour for Cheetah Super Attack
- Adjustments to sword throw positioning behaviour for Lion Super Attack
- Adjustments to Shiryoku pull/push and objects behaviour
- Fix to audio for Unarmed STYLE attack triggering in certain circumstances
- Controller compatibility adjusted for DS4 support
- Minor UI changes in Main Menu/Pause Menu
